# Avenize

> Avenize is an AI-powered business operating system — one connected platform
> for CRM, sales, finance, people/HR, operations, meetings, and business
> intelligence. It replaces a stack of disconnected tools (CRM + project
> management + accounting + HR + spreadsheets) with a single system where
> every module shares one data model, one security boundary, and one
> intelligence layer (the Business Brain).

## What Avenize is

- A multi-tenant business operating system for small and mid-sized companies,
  including groups with parent companies and subsidiaries.
- Module areas: CRM & sales pipeline, invoicing & payments, expenses &
  budgets, payroll, projects & tasks, inventory & procurement, HR (leave,
  attendance, appraisals), meetings with recording & transcription, company
  communication, and executive intelligence.
- The Business Brain: an intelligence layer that classifies business state,
  diagnoses metric changes, recommends the next best action, and tracks the
  value outcomes of accepted recommendations.
- Multi-subsidiary: organizations can contain a parent company and
  subsidiaries with per-subsidiary workspaces and consolidated visibility.
- Security model: row-level security per business, role-based access,
  multi-factor authentication, audit trails, and approval workflows.

## What Avenize is NOT

- Not an accounting-only app, not only a CRM, and not a chat tool.
- Not a social-media management suite — marketing capabilities connect to
  official platform APIs directly, without a third-party scheduler.

## Pricing

- Paid tiers billed in Nigerian Naira (NGN), ₦15,000–₦380,000/month; there is
  no free trial — subscriptions are paid from the first payment. Founding
  pricing applies during the founding period. See
  https://avenize.com/pricing for the current tiers.
